Its clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that order's requester. answer is {"order_code": ..., "ordered": ...}: order_code (string: the order's first code.coding code) and ordered (its authoredOn date, YYYY-MM-DD). Change nothing else in the chart.
